title: enactic/openarm
abstract:
A fully open-source humanoid arm for physical AI research and deployment in contact-rich environments.

# OpenArm **OpenArm** is an open-source 7DOF humanoid arm designed for physical AI research and deployment in contact-rich environments. With high backdrivability and compliance, it is built with safe human-robot interaction in mind while delivering practical payload capabilities for real-world applications. **OpenArm Cell** (on the right) is a standardized environment with unified background, lighting, and camera placement. Research performed using OpenArm can be reproduced around the world in consistent evaluation conditions, facilitating the global discussion on state of the art physical AI research. OpenArm features **human-scale** proportions, safety and compliance, and practical payloads. At $6,500 USD for a complete bimanual system, it provides a flexible platform for teleoperation, imitation learning, simulation, and real-world data collection in contact-rich tasks. *We're in continuous development and actively seeking contributors, research partners, and company collaborators to shape the next generation of practical humanoid systems. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：开源一套7自由度人形手臂OpenArm，强调高反向驱动性与柔顺性，配合标准化的OpenArm Cell环境（统一背景、光照和相机位姿），提供完整硬件图纸、文档和社区支持，支持遥操作、模仿学习、仿真与真实数据采集。


# 一、动机

> 现有机器人手臂成本高、封闭且难以复现，缺乏统一评估环境，阻碍了物理AI在接触丰富任务中的研究进展。


# 二、方法

> 开源一套7自由度人形手臂OpenArm，强调高反向驱动性与柔顺性，配合标准化的OpenArm Cell环境（统一背景、光照和相机位姿），提供完整硬件图纸、文档和社区支持，支持遥操作、模仿学习、仿真与真实数据采集。


# 三、核心实验结果

> OpenArm为人类尺度7自由度手臂，完整双手机器人系统售价6500美元，可在全球范围内以一致条件复现实验，用于接触丰富任务的灵巧操作。


# 四、对我的启发

> 低成本开源硬件可降低具身智能研究门槛，但当前社区和生态尚在起步，需更多贡献者参与；标准化评估环境对跨实验室对比和物理AI基准测试具有重要价值。
